allow: PowerShell(Write-Output "===== git diff --check ====="; $out = git diff --check 2>$null; if \([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace\($out\)\) { Write-Output "  CLEAN - no whitespace errors" } else { $out })

PowerShell(Write-Output "===== git diff --stat ====="; git diff --stat 2>$null | Select-Object -Last 8; Write-Output "`n===== git status --short ====="; git status --short 2>$null; Write-Output "`n===== staged? \(should be empty\) ====="; $s = git diff --cached --name-only 2>$null; if \([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace\($s\)\) { Write-Output "  nothing staged" } else { $s })
